example:
import { CollapseGroup } from "@godxjp/ui/general";

<Flex as="ul" marker="none" direction="col" gap="none">
  <CollapseGroup>{items.map((item) => <ListRow key={item.id} as="li" title={item.title} />)}</CollapseGroup>
</Flex>
name: CollapseGroup

props.description: The list's KEYED children (rows). Each must accept a `ref` and spread unknown props onto its root (every @godxjp/ui row does, e.g. `ListRow as="li"`).
props.name: children

props.description: Called with the child's own key once it has collapsed and unmounted.
props.name: onExited

related: StepTransition — swaps a whole step; CollapseGroup removes one row from a list.
ListRow — the row it usually animates.
tagline: A removed list child COLLAPSES (its measured height, block padding/margin and opacity → 0) before it unmounts, so the rows under it slide up instead of jumping. Works with plain React removal: filter the array. No wrapper element; reduced motion removes at once.
usage: DO put it directly inside the list element and pass the keyed rows: `<Flex as="ul" marker="none" direction="col" gap="none"><CollapseGroup>{pending.map((item) => <ListRow key={item.id} as="li" … />)}</CollapseGroup></Flex>` — remove an item from `pending` and it collapses out (an agreed requirement moving to 完了済み).

While it leaves, the row is `inert` + `aria-hidden` and carries `data-leaving`; move focus to a sensible neighbour yourself if the removed row held it. Duration `--collapse-exit-duration` (--duration-slow) on --ease-emphasized; under prefers-reduced-motion it is removed at once.
useCases: A to-do / required-action row that disappears once done.
Removing a session, token or invitation from a short list.
